name: 86 Chaos 17.0.19
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.19
releaseTitle: Release Gate Expected Version Pinning Repair
notes: Pins full Play Store certification to the version in package.json so stale CHAOS_EXPECTED_VERSION values in PowerShell or .env.test.local cannot block the next sequential release.

Removes CHAOS_EXPECTED_VERSION from full-gate release-target conflict checks while preserving strict URL, project, source-manifest, commit, branch, deployed-version, and Firebase testing-boundary validation.
Keeps non-certification preflight behavior strict: an explicitly configured expected version can still be used and mismatches still fail outside full certification.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.19
summary: Surgical release-gate repair that makes package.json the authoritative expected version during full certification.
description: Prevents stale persisted expected-version settings from blocking a valid newly deployed release while retaining all deployment identity and safety checks.
